description: This file defines the PerformanceTrackerLogDao class in the OrangeHRM project, specifically for managing PerformanceTrackerLog entity database operations, including retrieval, saving, deleting, and querying performance tracker logs.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerLogDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for PerformanceTrackerLog entity, providing methods to perform CRUD and specific queries related to performance tracking logs.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerLogById
methods.description: Fetches a PerformanceTrackerLog entity by its ID if it is not marked as deleted.

methods.name: getExistingPerformanceTrackerLogIdsForTrackerId
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of performance tracker logs that exist for a specified tracker ID and a list of log IDs.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerLogsByTrackerId
methods.description: Gets a list of performance tracker logs filtered by tracker ID and other filter parameters.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerLogQueryBuilder
methods.description: Builds a query for fetching performance tracker logs based on filter parameters, with sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerLogsRateCount
methods.description: Counts the number of logs for a specific performance tracker ID and rating type.

methods.name: savePerformanceTrackerLog
methods.description: Persists a PerformanceTrackerLog entity to the database.

methods.name: deletePerformanceTrackerLog
methods.description: Marks specific performance tracker logs as deleted based on their IDs.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerLogIdsByUserId
methods.description: Fetches IDs of logs associated with a specific user ID.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerLogsIdList
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of all performance tracker logs that are not associated with purged employees.
